user.title: Connect to Atrea unit
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Atrea ventilation unit.

data_description.ip_address: The IP address or hostname of the Atrea unit.
data_description.port: The HTTP port of the Atrea web interface (default 80).
data_description.password: Password for the unit, if one is configured. Leave blank if none.
data_description.name: Friendly name for this unit in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Atrea unit
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {ip_address} is no longer valid. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: Current password for the Atrea unit. Leave blank if none is set.

error.not_atrea_unit: The device at this address is not a supported Atrea unit.

init.title: Atrea options
init.description: Configure fan speeds and which presets are exposed.

data_description.fan_modes: Comma-separated list of fan speeds (percent), e.g. 12,20,30,40,50,60,70,80,90,100.
